issues.where: lower-left disk and bottom terrain; native in image-08 crops S, T and U, and image-06 crop D
issues.what: the surface is raked into parallel combed streaks and fine detail is gone at native size
issues.fix: remove the directional stretch and rebuild those areas with isotropic grain

issues.where: crops A, G and H, and image-07 crops O and P, across the mid disk and shadowed terrain
issues.what: the same near-horizontal smear continues through the lit face and ridges; stars and the limb stay sharp, so it is surface stretch, not camera blur
issues.fix: drop the anisotropic filter on the planet shader and restore native micro-detail

issues.where: crop A, central chevron of the globe
issues.what: cloud strands run in parallel hair-like strokes and read as painted
issues.fix: break the strands into overlapping turbulent scales

issues.what: the magenta discharges sit flat on the cloud tops with a hard local glow
issues.fix: scatter the light into the cloud volume and soften the cores

issues.where: Crops K and L, upper globe and storm eye
issues.what: Bright cloud detail stretches into long ribbons near the top and compresses into smooth concentric bands around the eye. The fine texture follows the same warp as the large forms.
issues.fix: Lay out the storm and upper cloud field in sphere space, then add independent small-scale cloud breakup so fine detail does not inherit the same stretch.

issues.where: Crops A, D and F, mid-globe and shadowed lower hemisphere
issues.what: Crisp, granular ridges at mid-globe give way to broad directional smears in the surrounding dark surface. The loss of detail affects whole swaths, not just the foreshortened edge.
issues.fix: Restore multiscale texture in the shadowed surface, and blend it continuously into the sharper central detail without simply lifting the shadows.

issues.where: Crops U and V, lower and lower-right limb
issues.what: A narrow orange inner trace sits inside a much softer brown outer halo, giving the lower-right limb a doubled, layered look.
issues.fix: Blend the inner trace with the outer atmospheric falloff and taper its brightness more gradually into the shadowed limb.

issues.where: Crops V, W and X, lower foreground cloud banks
issues.what: The shadowed cloud interiors lose their fine structure and run into parallel diagonal streaks, while the nearby sunlit rims resolve much more sharply.
issues.fix: Add subtle, low-contrast billow structure inside the foreground shadows and break up the streaks without sharpening the haze.
